rules.name: Codex Discipline
rules.legend: Deployed as a mutually supportive strike force that epitomises the flexibility and martial wisdom of the Codex Astartes, Space Marines have the answer to any strategic or tactical challenge.
rules.html: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.legend: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.legend: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.legend: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.legend: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
enhancements.legend: This venerable banner was carried in the Great Crusade, and its presence is a constant inspiration.
enhancements.html:
Ancient model only. This model has:
  • +1 OC and Ld.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.
  • The following ability:

    Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army): When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 A until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Laurels of Triumph
enhancements.legend: A rare honour, the Laurels of Triumph mark out a truly accomplished warrior even amongst the Angels of Death.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.legend: An ardent student of the Codex Astartes, this commander epitomises its tactical genius.
enhancements.html: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour
enhancements.legend: Crafted by the Chapter’s finest artificers, this suit of armour provides superior protection.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
  • 2+ Sv.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.

rules.name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
rules.legend: Space Marine armoured formations rapidly share cogitated targeting data to augment their already superb marksmanship and reaction times.
rules.html:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units’ (excluding walker units) ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • M.
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.legend: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.legend: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
enhancements.legend: This ancient war machine has endured millennia of battle, and its belligerent machine spirit has only become more obdurant.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit:
  • Has 5+ InSv.
  • At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound.

enhancements.name: Gunnery Honours
enhancements.legend: The crew of this war machine demonstrate exemplary gunnery and have earned the highest honours for their craft.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit’s ranged attacks have [Heavy].

rules.name: Lightning-fast Strike
rules.legend: Racing into battle at breakneck speeds, Space Marine fast-attack squadrons often punch into the enemy lines before the foe even realises their peril.
rules.html: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.legend: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit is selected to make an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.legend: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Supercharged Engines
enhancements.legend: Built from ancient and dimly understood designs, these engines generate incredible power and torque.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines
enhancements.legend: Fitted to the Chapter’s swift grav-speeders, these vigilant devices runelock the positions of enemy forces, laying them bare to the Space Marines’ wrath.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted:
  • While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range.

rules.name: Mission Tactics
rules.legend:
Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.

FUROR TACTICS When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.

MALLEUS TACTICS When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.

PURGATUS TACTICS By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.
rules.html:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

With the exception of Kill Team Cassius (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH units.

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Have +6" R.
  • Have +1 S.

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
stratagems.legend: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT:
  • Place your unit in strategic reserves.
  • If your unit has Kill Team, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: The Thief of Secrets
enhancements.legend: The Thief of Secrets is a blade whose machine spirit has an unquenchable thirst for knowledge. It has tasted the vitae of countless alien races, absorbing those liquids through auto-sanctified sanguinator-channels and codifying them through the honeycombed array of logicum cells within. The biological secrets of many xenos races have thus been laid bare, allowing the blade’s user to modulate its power field, the better to slice through chitinous armour, rupture xenoform organs and burn out alien nervous systems.
enhancements.html: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has:
  • Deep Strike.
  • When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: The Tome of Ectoclades
enhancements.legend: This grimoire, bound in the skin of the alien, holds the most powerful truths the Deathwatch have uncovered about their foes - whether xenos or those who harbour them - arming them with the best tactics and strategies to use against such threats.
enhancements.html: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, the assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Osseus Key (Aura)
enhancements.legend: The ancient clavis known as the Osseus Key is said to be the most powerful of its kind. Where other such devices are made from sanctified platinum, the Osseus Key is made from the hand and finger bones of deceased Imperial Fists heroes that fought in the Horus Heresy, scrimshawed with inhuman care and imbued with the fiercest machine spirits of the age. No portal can bar its bearer from entry, and no xenos machine can stand before his wrath.
enhancements.html: WATCH MASTER/TECHMARINE model only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6" of this model, that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 A.

rules.name: Vowed Target
rules.legend: Whether its true significance is kept a secret or not, there is a singular prize here that the Inner Circle have come to either secure or destroy. They will pursue this strategic objective with cold ferocity.
rules.html:
In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one objective. That objective is your vowed objective until your next Command phase.
  • Friendly Deathwing Infantry unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have +1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: WRATH OF THE LION
stratagems.legend: Channelling the strategic puissance and measured ferocity of their gene-sire, the veterans of the Unforgiven unleash a perfectly timed and utterly lethal storm of tightly controlled violence.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.legend: So driven by duty are the veterans of the Unforgiven that even death cannot keep them from it.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Deathwing unit.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: RELIC TELEPORTARIUM
stratagems.legend: The Deathwing employ ancient and incredibly powerful teleportariums, some older than the Great Crusade, to strike at their foes with unparalleled safety and accuracy.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit with the Deep Strike ability is selected to make an ingress move.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8").
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of this turn.

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.legend: This warrior lets nothing stand in their way or slow their advance, closing swiftly and relentlessly with their quarry.
enhancements.html: Deathwing model only. When this unit is selected to make a consolidation move, this unit can move up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.legend: Even amongst the elite of the Unforgiven, this warrior is a paragon of duty and martial might.
enhancements.html: Deathwing model only. This unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Drive Home the Blade
rules.legend: The Adeptus Astartes launch their shipboard strikes with precision and lethal momentum, sweeping aside each new obstruct ion to their progress and pressing ever forward.
rules.html: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to shoot, if one or more models from that unit are within 1" of an open Hatchway and every model in that unit is on the same side of that Hatchway, select one enemy unit on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [sustained hits 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
stratagems.legend: Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: CERAMITE BULWARK
stratagems.legend: The Space Marines present a wall of ceramite and plasteel shoulder guards to the breach as they force passage through.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

stratagems.name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
stratagems.legend: In the echoing confines of a voidship, the deafening battle cries of the Space Marines evoke terror in the foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
stratagems.legend: Even when wounded unto death, still the Adeptus Astartes fight on in hopes their final efforts will spell the difference between defeat and victory.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: Bestowed as a mark of honour, this venerated relic lends an extra layer of armour protection that proves especially useful amidst vicious void war.
enhancements.html: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Clavitine Reliquary
enhancements.legend: A timeless and unique example of Chapter artifice, this device rapidly synchronises with the data spirits of locking devices and renders them quiescent.
enhancements.html: In your Movement phase, each time the bearer is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, if it is within 1" of a Hatchway, it can attempt to operate that Hatchway. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

rules.name: Relentless Salvoes
rules.legend: These vanguard specialists stay on the move, laying down hails of fire to harass and disrupt their foes even as they hit-and-fade through chambers and corridors.
rules.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: KNIFE WORK
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Omni-Structural Auspex
enhancements.legend: A rare device with a potent and knowledgeable machine spirit, this implement analyses the integrity of foes’ armour and isolates weaknesses to exploit.
enhancements.html: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model (excluding Character models) makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Void Warrior
enhancements.legend: Having mastered the arts of shipboard warfare over many battles, this warrior moves swiftly through them and strikes with unerring skill.
enhancements.html: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Sacred Oath
rules.legend: Space Marine Chapters do not lightly commit their precious suits of Terminator armour to battle, nor the storied veterans who wear them. When they go to war, they always do so with a vital duty and a crucial target.
rules.html: Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, when you select a target for Oath of Moment, you can use this Detachment rule. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: CLEANSING SWEEP
stratagems.legend: Refined during the clearance of infested space hulks, these methodical tactics ensure no angle of approach goes undefended.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: TOWER OF STRENGTH
stratagems.legend: Each individual Terminator is a walking fortress. When they stand together they are truly indomitable.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start or end of any phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: FOCUSING SHRINE
stratagems.legend: An ancient device built into the structure of the teleportarium, this relic allows for incredibly accurate teleport assaults.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: CARVE A PATH
stratagems.legend: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

enhancements.name: Seal of Indomitability
enhancements.legend: This ancient honour is said to fortify the machine spirit of a suit of Terminator plate against even the most dolorous of blows.
enhancements.html: Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Resolute
enhancements.legend: Allowing nothing to bar his path, this champion of the Chapter ploughs a bloody path through the foe.
enhancements.html: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed, and each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

rules.name: Legacy of the Angel
rules.legend: Never do the Blood Angels stand taller or strive harder than when faced with seemingly impossible odds. At such times, the Sons of Sanguinius delve deep into their souls for preternatural reserves of determination, fury and focus. Sometimes, they even touch upon the uncertain gift of prophecy that was said to be their gene‑sire’s boon and his curse.
rules.html:
Friendly Blood Angels Character units:
  • Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
stratagems.legend: The enemy are engulfed in a soul-deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has:
  • Stealth.
  • -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: INSTANT OF GRACE
stratagems.legend: In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle-brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
stratagems.legend: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle-brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES
stratagems.legend: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly The Sanguinor/unengaged Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MEASURED STRATEGIST
stratagems.legend: Stern and level-headed, this Blood Angels commander is a beacon of composure amidst the tempest of his brothers’ fury, providing much-needed tactical guidance for his impetuous battle-brothers.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FURY
stratagems.legend: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: If your unit is a Character unit, have [LETHAL HITS], [LANCE].

enhancements.name: Prescient Flash
enhancements.legend: A flash of foresight and clarity sings through this warrior’s blood and guides his steps into battle.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Blazing Icon
enhancements.legend: What was before merely a decorative blood drop pendant now shines with a seemingly miraculous light as bright as any star. The foe are forced to avert their gaze from its wrathful magnificence.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice
enhancements.legend: Knowing only too well the desperate and vital nature of the battle before him, this scion of Sanguinius echoes his Primarch’s resolute determination to fight on even beyond what seems the doors of certain death.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Unto Death
enhancements.legend: Just as his Primarch before him, this warrior has foreseen his impending doom and goes towards it regardless, desperate to land a telling blow upon the foe before death claims him.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the turn this unit can:
  • Re-roll advance rolls.
  • Re-roll charge rolls.

rules.name: The Great Wolf Watches
rules.legend: The battle‑brothers of this Great Company know what their lord expects of them and stand ready to pounce the moment the foe are fool enough to stray within range.
rules.html:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Character units have the following ability:

Countercharge: (Once per battle round, per unit) When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

stratagems.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
stratagems.legend: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

stratagems.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
stratagems.legend: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE
stratagems.legend: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer
enhancements.legend: Possessed of a ferocious predatory instinct, this warrior leads swift and deadly encirclements and ambushes with peerless skill.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: A Giant Amongst Giants
enhancements.legend: Likened to a walking pinnacle of Fenrisian granite come to life, this hulking champion is an echo of Russ himself.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only.
  • This model has +2 W.
  • This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

rules.name: Dutiful Tenacity
rules.legend: Even amongst the Adeptus Astartes, the battle‑brothers of the Dark Angels are renowned for their tenacity and resilience on the battlefield. When ordered to war, they are utterly relentless in pursuing their objectives, wading into fields of withering fire and shrugging off blows that would slay mortal warriors outright.
rules.html:
Attacks that target friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted units with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: IN SACRIFICE, VICTORY
stratagems.legend: Those inducted into the Dark Angels’ Inner Circle will gladly give their lives in pursuit of victory, and to see the Fallen brought to justice.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit within range of an objective is destroyed.

TARGET: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.

EFFECT: Select one objective:
  • That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of.
  • That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase.
That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: LION'S WILL
stratagems.legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, Dark Angels battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
stratagems.legend: The Dark Angels are relentless in the pursuit of their foes, striking with ruthless ferocity and precision to take the heads of those who have crossed the Chapter.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That Adeptus Astartes unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL MASTERY
stratagems.legend: When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the Chapter’s tactical flexibility and mastery of rapid warfare.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
stratagems.legend: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Ravenwing unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That RAVENWING unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: RELICS OF THE DARK AGE
stratagems.legend: Amongst the many secrets hoarded by the Dark Angels are those technological in nature. The armouries of the Rock contain potent weapons unseen in the armouries of other Chapters.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.legend: A veteran of the Inner Circle, this warrior inspires those around them to hold the line amidst the heat and chaos of battle.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.legend: This commander has mastered the art of cavalry combat, instinctively noticing the opportune position to strike and navigating the chaos of battle with preternatural precision.
enhancements.html: Ravenwing model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.legend: A veteran inductee of the Inner Circle, this champion has served amongst the Deathwing for centuries and become an unmatched master of teleportarium insertions.
enhancements.html: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.legend: The vaults of the Dark Angels contain many relics from Humanity’s distant past. This soldier has been granted the honour of bearing such a weapon to battle.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks:
  • Have +2 S.
  • Have +1 AP.

rules.name: Legendary Slayers
rules.legend: Some Space Wolves seek only to bring down the most monstrous and deadly foes. With hunting packs of Fenrisian wolves, Thunderwolf Cavalry and rampaging bands of Wulfen, they seek to hunt down and slay mighty champions, towering monstrosities and rumbling war machines, demoralising the foe and earning glorious victories.
rules.html: Attacks made by friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: UNBRIDLED FEROICITY
stratagems.legend: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: CO-ORDINATED STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: IMPETUOSITY
stratagems.legend: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit has shot.

TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Hunter's Guile
enhancements.legend: Adeptus Astartes model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Wolf-Touched
enhancements.legend: Whilst the Canis Helix has yet to overcome this champion fully, it is stirred to life by the thrill of battle and the scent of blood.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has:
  • Wulfen.
  • +2" M.

rules.name: Vulkan's Quest
rules.legend: Tireless in his pursuit of the Primarch’s legacy, Forgefather Vulkan He’stan annihilates any who impede his quest. Favouring swift, aggressive assaults, he and his warriors close rapidly with the enemy, destroying them at close range with ruthless efficiency
rules.html:
• You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
  • Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12", have +1 S.

If your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit, friendly Infernus Squad units have the following:
  • When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
  • When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagems.legend: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagems.legend: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagems.legend: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
  • Make a disembark move.
  • Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Torrent weapons:
  • Do not have [Blast].
  • Have [Close-Quarters].
  • Have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Forged in Battle
enhancements.legend: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle-brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to:
  • BS.
  • WS.
  • Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D.

enhancements.name: War Tempered Artifice
enhancements.legend: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death-dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • +1 D.

enhancements.name: Immolator
enhancements.legend: Steeped in the Promethean Cult, this battle-brother wields the flamer with unparalleled mastery, turning the battlefield into a burning pyre for the corpses of his foes.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s [TORRENT] weapons have +1 A.

rules.name: Shadow Tactics
rules.legend: The Raven Guard are renowned for their uncanny ability to move unseen, cloaking themselves in darkness as they close in upon their prey. Aethon Shaan is a true master at harnessing these abilities, withdrawing and redeploying his battle-brothers to draw the enemy out of formation.
rules.html:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth.

Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units have -3" detection range.

Friendly Aethon Shaan units have the following ability:

Unparalleled Tactician: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP.

stratagems.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
stratagems.legend: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: FEINT AND THRUST
stratagems.legend: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
stratagems.legend: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS FUSILLADE
stratagems.legend: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • +1 BS.
  • +1 AP.

stratagems.name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
stratagems.legend: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If your unit is a Phobos/Scout Squad unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: INTO DARKNESS
stratagems.legend: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Blackwing Shroud
enhancements.legend: This mechanical device contains miniaturised refraction fields and electromagnetic interference projectors that distort sensory apparatus, enabling the bearer and their unit to evade detection and infiltrate key positions.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

enhancements.name: Umbral Raptor
enhancements.legend: This warrior is a solitary predator whose footsteps are all but silent and whose form is one with the shadows.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes infantry model only. This model has:
  • Fights First.
  • Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Instincts
enhancements.legend: Those who master the Path of Ambush guide their forces to launch surprise assaults on the enemy with the precise timing of true hunters.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Coronal Susurrant
enhancements.legend: This wreath of circuitry from the Dark Age of Technology forces a whispering white noise into enemy minds and broadcasts, impeding communications and interrupting the chain of command.
enhancements.html: Phobos model only. Each enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player stratagems.

rules.name: Storm-swift Onslaught
rules.legend: The White Scars are masters of high‑speed tactics and hit‑and‑run warfare. They do battle on the move and from the saddle, outwitting their enemies with breakneck manoeuvres and melting away one moment only to crash home with bone‑crushing force the next.
rules.html:
• You can select the assault doctrine or tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
  • Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +1 to advance rolls.

Friendly Suboden Khan units have the following ability:

Wrath of the First Khan: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:
  • If this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If this unit is engaged, this unit can make a fall-back move.

Restrictions: Your army can include White Scars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
stratagems.legend: Skilled Space Marine riders can guide their steeds through even the densest and most treacherous terrain to strike their foes from the position they least expect.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes mounted unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
stratagems.legend: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: Have [LANCE].
  • Or: If your unit has Mounted, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
stratagems.legend: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
stratagems.legend: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
stratagems.legend: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire-and-manoeuvre strategies.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:
  • That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
  • Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
stratagems.legend: Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Stormseer's Wisdom
enhancements.legend: The Chapter’s Librarians have made this champion privy to omens of great threats in future wars. Armed with this knowledge, they lead their warriors to war with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Chogorian Huntmaster
enhancements.legend: This mounted huntsman knows well the importance of manoeuvre, outflanking the enemy and ambushing unsuspecting foes from the flanks and rear, the better to land the killing blow.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit only. When this unit is selected to make an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Eye
enhancements.legend: This augmetic eye enhances the user’s visual spectrum, enabling them to pinpoint heat signatures and cogitate appropriate firing solutions.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Have [IGNORES COVER].
  • Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Spearpoint Paragon
enhancements.legend: Decades of service within the White Scars First Company have helped this superlative warrior master the violent arts of high-speed combat.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If this unit made a charge move this turn, +2 S and AP.

rules.name: Mastered Doctrines
rules.legend: Marneus Calgar deploys the complete and nuanced wisdom of the Codex Astartes as easily and instinctively as drawing breath.
rules.html: If your army includes a Marneus Calgar unit, you can select the assault doctrine/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine each one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
stratagems.legend: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
stratagems.legend: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
stratagems.legend: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
stratagems.legend: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
stratagems.legend: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth - theoretical and practical - of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Student of the Codex
enhancements.legend: This prodigal officer has focused upon one aspect of the Codex Astartes and means to master its every aspect before moving on to the next.
enhancements.html: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Armour of Antoninus
enhancements.legend: Originally worn by a storied Captain of the Ultramarines’ First Company, this artificer armour is bestowed by the Chapter Master himself upon a worthy wearer.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
  • 2+ Sv.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Oath of Macragge
enhancements.legend: Amongst the most solemn and binding oaths an Ultramarine can swear, it is a rare honour to enter battle with these words affixed to their armour.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

enhancements.name: Veteran of Behemoth
enhancements.legend: Having battled the Tyranid swarms since their first galactic invasion, this veteran officer knows well the benefit of efficient and overwhelming firepower.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

rules.name: Master of Wolves
rules.legend:
When the Great Wolf Logan Grimnar leads his packs to war, it is certain that mighty deeds will be done and epic verses added to the sagas of many a Space Wolf. There is none amongst the sons of Russ who can command such instinctive authority throughout his Chapter, none who so deftly wields warrior and war engine like a single great pack. In the sight of their lord, every Space Wolf aspires to be a champion of Fenris and strives with ever-greater determination to prove themselves worthy of his regard. Grimnar masterfully directs the hunt from its very heart, orchestrating every element like an apex predator herding its prey to destruction. Where restraint is needed, he sees it exercised. Where focused fury must be unleashed, he is its master and embodiment both. So does the saga of Logan Grimnar grow ever greater for the telling.

HOWLING ONSLAUGHT
When the Great Wolf gives the command, his packs descend upon the foe in a coordinated and utterly devastating strike.
rules.html:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLES units) with this ability have the following abilities:

Encircling Jaws: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

Hunter’s Eye: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Ferocious Strike: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit with 9" have [Sustained Hits 1].

Friendly Logan Grimnar units have the following ability:

Howling Onslaught: (Once per battle, per army) In your command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly Adeptus Astartes Monster/Vehicle units benefit from the Master of Wolves rule until the start of your next command phase.

Restrictions: Your army can include Space Wolves units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: GRIMNAR'S COMMAND
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: FANGS OF THE PACK
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Fighting as one, these champions of Fenris fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: WOLF TOTEMS
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE PACK
stratagems.type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Once a pack of Fenrisian warriors has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of a foe, they all strike at once, like encircling predators dragging down their prey.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

enhancements.name: Howlmaw
enhancements.legend: An ancient hunting horn with a built-in vox amplification unit, this relic’s stirring howl can be heard even through the wild clangour of battle.
enhancements.html: Wolf Priest model only. (Once per turn, per unit) At the start of the fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of this model. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Grimnar's Mark
enhancements.legend: This moonsilver wolf-talisman is bestowed by the Great Wolf himself before battle, a mark of favour that fills the bearer with an eagerness to slay the foe.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. (Once per battle round, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress/Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
  • That use is -1CP.
  • That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Chariots of the Storm
enhancements.legend: This dedicated flight of gunships attends the Great Wolf and his packs, and can be called in to rapidly reposition his forces in the moments before battle is joined.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Skjald's Foretelling
enhancements.legend: Great deeds have been prophesied for this champion, such that those who fight alongside him do so all the harder as they play out the self-fulfilling prophecy.
enhancements.html: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

rules.name: Focused Response
rules.legend: The battle-brothers of the Shield Chapters commit their boarding strikes with a measured and meticulous application of force. They storm one section after the next while maintaining heightened awareness of lurking threats, and readying themselves to launch devastating counterattacks.
rules.html:
• Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
  • Each time an enemy unit makes an attack that targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is Set To Defend, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

stratagems.name: RAPID TAKEOVER
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

stratagems.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

stratagems.name: CODEX WARFARE
stratagems.type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Speartip of the Chapter
enhancements.legend: A veteran of countless boarding strikes, this warrior leads their battle-brothers in a vanguard breach that drives into the foe's heart.
enhancements.html: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit and up to one other friendly unit within the same Entry Zone can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Tolorek Data Djinn
enhancements.legend: Gifted by the Tech-Priests of Tolorek for the cleansing of Ultramar, this powerful cyberspirit uses brute force technoscreed when entreated to overwhelm the systems of enemy ships, conquering them and yoking their protocols to the bearer's will.
enhancements.html: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

rules.name: Adaptive Defence
rules.legend: These Space Marines are experts in fighting from rapidly prepared defensive positions. They are able to maximise the potential of almost any terrain to serve as an ad-hoc strongpoint, rapidly assessing optimal firing lines and punishing the foe’s every attempt to advance and dislodge them.
rules.html:
• While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are entrenched while all of the following apply:
    • That unit is within a terrain area.
    • That unit was not set up this turn.
    • No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.

  • Friendly Darnath Lysander/Tor Garadon units have the following ability:
Defensive Mastery: At the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched.

DARNATH LYSANDER’s/TOR GARADON’s unit is always entrenched, regardless of the conditions listed above.

Restrictions: Your army can include Imperial Fists units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
stratagems.legend: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
stratagems.legend: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
stratagems.legend: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: STAND TO THE END
stratagems.legend: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:
  • Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
stratagems.legend: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Honour Indefatigable
enhancements.legend: This rare honour badge celebrates a warrior who refuses to give up, even in the face of apparently certain death.
enhancements.html:
Gravis model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Castellum Omnivox
enhancements.legend: This unique vox-and-augur augmetic provides the bearer with unparalleled tactical data vital to coordinating an aggressive defence in battle.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. When this unit makes a advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Defensive Mastery
enhancements.legend: Few officers of the Chapter can match this commander’s talent for cunning defensive troop dispositions.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.
