enhancements.name: Spy-skull Data Link
enhancements.legend: Several artificer-crafted and heavily shrouded servo-skulls are tethered to this device, their linked visual feeds making the bearer nigh impossible to evade.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].

rules.name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
rules.legend: Uncompromising in their faith, a crusade's Sword Brethren are blazing beacons of intolerant resolve capable of holding back hordes of blasphemous foes from sites sacred to the Black Templars.
rules.html:
In the Fight phase, if a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.legend: The largest manifestations of the foe's sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade's champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.legend: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stroke their executioners' hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor's wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.legend: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

enhancements.name: Fervent Exemplars
enhancements.legend: Paragons of their crusade's inexorable wrath, these Sword Brethren have earned a reputation for carving a path to victory through their foes, unable to rest while one enemy yet lives.
enhancements.html: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Inheritors of Sigismund
enhancements.legend: These warrior elites have achieved feats of bloody slaughter against the most deadly of the God-Emperor's foes, executing them in displays of such blisteringly swift attacks that it is clear they share a sliver of Sigismund's own skill.
enhancements.html: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has Fights First.

rules.name: Wrath of Angels
rules.legend: Few living warriors embody the ideal of the Emperor's wrathful angels more than the Sanguinary Guard, for they appear without warning to wreak death and destruction before surging on to the next foe with shocking speed.
rules.html:
The tactical doctrine is active for Sanguinary Guard units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
stratagems.legend: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
stratagems.legend: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter's wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit form your army ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs' nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has:
  • Stealth.
  • -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination
enhancements.legend: Granted a glimmer of foresight by his genetic inheritance, this Son of Sanguinius has identified a foe whose future is drenched in the blood of the Imperium. Such an enemy cannot be allowed to live.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. (once per battle, per army) When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner
enhancements.legend: This deadly duellist leads his battle-brothers in masterful strikes capable of carving through their armoured or swarming foes with breathtaking fluidity.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

rules.name: Sanguinius' Fury
rules.legend: Swept up in visions of the Primarch’s blood-drenched final hours, the Lost throw themselves upon the foe, channelling the Great Angel’s fury and striving their utmost to emulate his mastery of close-quarters combat.
rules.html:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
  • At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.
  • The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit.
This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: With their perceptions twisted, the battle-brothers of the Death Company transmute loss into the worst of ancient betrayals and seek only to sever such treachery from existence.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Death Company unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

TARGET: That enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle:
  • While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units’ attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
stratagems.legend: Knowing in what remains of his mind that his is a sorrow-filled mission of galactic consequence, this ancient interred warrior permits nothing to stand in his way.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly Death Company Dreadnought unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: RAGE-FUELLED RESPONSE
stratagems.legend: They may no longer recognise the foe before them, but the Lost Brethren are sane enough to identify an attack and capable of responding with a violent surge and a howl of wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Death Company unit has shot.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception
enhancements.legend: Proudly is Sanguinius remembered for his rapid intercession in the protection of his gene-sons. Driven on by death visions, this lost warrior is a tragic monument to such glory.
enhancements.html: Death Company model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
enhancements.legend: Lost to a memory shard of the Primarch, in this warrior's mind, he has entered the Archtraitor's sanctum, and all that stands between him and Horus is a host of massing traitors.
enhancements.html: Death Company model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

rules.name: Black-winged Vigilance
rules.legend: The anti-grav skimmers and combat aircraft of the Ravenwing bristle not only with potent weapons but also with powerful augurs and trackers, whose sleepless machine spirits are as vigilant as the black-armoured battle-brothers.
rules.html:
Friendly Ravenwing Fly units’ ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Friendly Outrider squad units have BATTLELINE.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: WINGS OF SHADOW
stratagems.legend: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Ravenwing Fly/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Stealth.

stratagems.name: SKYBORNE SURVEILLANCE
stratagems.legend: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: WE ARE VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: The Ravenwing's aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Thundercowl Turbines
enhancements.legend: These master-wrought engines from the Dark Ages of Technology churn the gloom emanated by the Ravenwing's reliquaries into a billowing cawl that shrouds their advance, allowing them to strike when the foe least expects.
enhancements.html: Ravenwing Fly/Ravenwing Mounted unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Nightforged Battery
enhancements.legend: Use of these relic plasma storm batteries is granted only by dispensation of the Master of the Rock. They unleash devastating toroids of searing plasma, while their venting subsystems are known to be especially vigilant.
enhancements.html:
Land Speeder Vengeance unit only. This unit can re-roll:
  • Rolls to determine the A of a weapon.
  • Hazard rolls.

rules.name: Mission Tactics
rules.legend: Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.
rules.html:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics

When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.

If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics

When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.

If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics

By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.

If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • Have +6" R.
  • Have +1 S.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has:
  • Deep Strike.
  • When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

rules.name: Templar Vows
rules.legend: On the eve of battle, the Black Templars gather to be led in prayer and contemplation by their champions. United in their hatred of the foe, they swear a mighty vow to uphold in the battle ahead.
rules.html:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle.

Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit:
  • Have [PRECISION].
  • Have [LANCE].

Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s S have +1 to wound rolls.

Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly INFANTRY units have:
  • At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
  • When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
stratagems.legend: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: PIOUS ENMITY
stratagems.legend: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund’s heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHAPLIN/JUDICIAR unit.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: DEVOUT PUSH
stratagems.legend: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy’s lines.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
stratagems.legend: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
stratagems.legend: To face the Emperor’s transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
stratagems.legend: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS and WS.
  • Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Augury Servo-host
enhancements.legend: This warrior’s auto-senses are linked to a circling host of servo-skulls crafted from the remains of favoured serfs and failed neophytes. Fitted with ocular probes and sensor vanes, they provide the Black Templar with advanced targeting information to pick out the unbelievers who cower in concealment.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.legend: The piety and honour of this warrior can be felt wherever he fights. His presence rouses the ardent souls of the Black Templars, warding Sigismund’s heirs from the blasphemy of the unbeliever.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Animus
enhancements.legend: This inspirational warrior exudes fierce contempt and loathing for the Emperor’s foes, inciting such apoplectic revulsion in their battle-brothers as to drive their blows with vicious strength.
enhancements.html: Chaplain/Judiciar model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Zealous Vanguard
enhancements.legend: This warrior is an unstoppable crusader whose hearts burn like twin pyres of eager zeal. Ever at the forefront of combat, he leads his warriors as the tip of the crusade’s blade.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

rules.name: Purge and Sanctify
rules.legend: As the battle-brothers of a Vindication Task Force purge the Emperor’s domain in fire and blood, they see their holy quest as recovering Humanity’s rightful dominion. They scour the stain of the unclean, topple false idols, breach strongholds of unholy faith and plant the crusade’s standards in their place, branding such sites with the sacred icons of their brotherhood.
rules.html:
Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.legend: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Crusader Squad unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.legend: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.legend: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Righteous Fervour
enhancements.legend: With their zealous hatred stoked red-hot by furious sermons and inflammatory prayers, Companions of Vehemence are filled with a wrathful vigour. Only the deaths of the God-Emperor’s enemies can assuage their fury, and they will let nothing delay them from unleashing it.
enhancements.html: CRUSADER SQUAD unit only. This unit can re-roll Advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Exemplar
enhancements.legend: With a ceaseless and booming oratory, this commander exhorts his warriors in their duty to the Emperor. Honour, he declaims, must be pursued relentlessly.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

rules.name: Armoured Wrath
rules.html:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
  • If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
    • Re-roll one hit roll.
    • Re-roll one wound roll.
    • Re-roll one damage roll.
  • Otherwise you can:
    • Re-roll one hit roll.
    • Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
    • Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.legend: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for deadly demise.

TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Change any deadly demise rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: SPIRITS OF IRON
stratagems.legend: These warriors emulate the mechanical monstrosities at whose side they fight, shrugging off wounds both physical and spiritual.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel no pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.legend: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has:
  • +1" M.
  • +1 T.
  • +1 Ld.
  • +1 OC.
  • +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.legend: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even severely injured, they will never abandon their oaths.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below starting strength.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS and WS.
  • Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using:
  • Snap shooting.
  • Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting.
While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: METHODICAL BRUTALITY
stratagems.legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

SECONDARY EFFECT:
  • If your unit is a VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Target Augury Web
enhancements.legend: This spearhead commander uses advanced augmetics to distribute targeting data. With these, they direct the fire of their war engine crews and rouse their machine spirits to operative superiority.
enhancements.html: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

enhancements.name: Adept of the Omnissiah
enhancements.legend: This battle-brother is steeped in hidden technological rites. Should their armoured charges be threatened, a burst of arcane Binharic screed can rouse their machine spirits to vigilance.
enhancements.html: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

enhancements.name: Master of the Machine War
enhancements.legend:
This commander is supremely gifted in the strategies of armoured warfare, understanding the capabilities of every war engine in the Chapter’s arsenal. Delivering precision orders, they ensure the vehicles under their command inflict the most punishing damage to the
enemy even amidst complex manoeuvres.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this model and then select the devastator doctrine or tactical doctrine. That doctrine is active for that VEHICLE unit until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: The Flesh is Weak
enhancements.legend: The injuries of past battles have seen this warrior heavily rebuilt with ultra-durable cybernetic limbs and organs that render them extremely difficult to kill.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model:
  • Has +1 T.
  • Has Feel No Pain 5+.

rules.name: Combined Deployment
rules.legend: Space Marine crews train to provide armoured fire support to their debarked passengers while on the attack.
rules.html:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
  • While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.legend: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.legend: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

enhancements.name: Linebreaker Onslaught
enhancements.legend: These battle-brothers excel in bursting from the cover of their transport and straight into the enemy lines.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
  • This unit can re-roll charge rolls.
  • Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Damocles-class Uplink
enhancements.legend: This portable strat-shrine plugs directly into the bearer’s armour, enhancing their command and control abilities.
enhancements.html: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that INFANTRY unit.

rules.name: Shadow Masters
rules.legend: Holding to the shadows and choosing victims with care, Phobos-armoured Astartes winnow the enemy ranks without ever revealing their positions.
rules.html:
When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot:
  • Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
  • Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.legend: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.legend: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
  • That objective is no longer snared.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
enhancements.html:
Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy
enhancements.legend: This war leader excels in harrying tactics, wielding their strike force like a weapon of utmost stealth and cunning.
enhancements.html: Phobos model only. In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is <u>not</u> eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Wrath of the Chapter
rules.legend: When the Space Marines are roused to true martial fury, they bring their vengeance to their adversaries with the inescapable speed of a lightning strike.
rules.html: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.legend: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.legend: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

enhancements.name: Martial Paragon
enhancements.legend: Leading his battle-brothers by example, this champion of the Chapter strives to embody the martial teachings of the Codex Astartes.
enhancements.html:
Tacticus model only. This unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

enhancements.name: Spearpoint War Leader
enhancements.legend: Once the enemy are sighted, this warrior leads the attack from the very front, striving to be first in amongst the foe’s ranks.
enhancements.html: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

rules.name: Vanguard Ambushers
rules.legend: Few experiences are so terrifying for Mankind’s enemies as finding themselves the victims of Phobos-armoured ambushers.
rules.html: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.legend: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Phobos unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.legend: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Phobos unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Seal of Shrouding
enhancements.legend: Built into what appears a simple wax purity seal, this device scrambles enemy targeting when the bearer is on the move.
enhancements.html: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
enhancements.html:
Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

rules.name: Death Blow
rules.legend: Veterans of a hundred decapitating strikes, these First Company warriors know that if they land their first blow with sufficiently furious momentum, they will need no second.
rules.html: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.legend: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.legend: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Lethal Hits].
  • [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.legend: Few are the enemies this warrior has not faced and bested, and they remember the vulnerabilities of every defeated foe.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.legend: This archeotech teleportation stabiliser is unique, a relic of Dark Age technology that spirits its bearer swiftly through the tides of the Warp.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

rules.name: Assault Mastery
rules.legend: Space Marines who specialise in close-quarters brutality truly embody their sobriquet ‘Angels of Death’.
rules.html: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.legend: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting their final justice upon the Emperor’s foes.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.legend: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Lance].
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [Lance] and +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Imperium's Sword
enhancements.legend: This champion hurls himself forwards with unbridled ferocity, cutting down the foe like a reaping whirlwind.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Furious Assault
enhancements.legend: Bellicose temperament and advanced training combine to make this unit especially terrifying on the charge.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

rules.name: Walking Fortress
rules.legend: With their plan in motion and targets designated, Gravis-armoured warriors stride unstoppably into battle as they lay down withering hails of firepower.
rules.html:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Do not have [Heavy].
  • Have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.legend: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Gravis unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.legend: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Indefatigable Fortitude
enhancements.legend: Renowned for being a living engine of war, this warrior inspires his comrades to shrug off even the most devastating attacks.
enhancements.html: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Relentless Advance
enhancements.legend: Ever on the move, this warrior leads his battle-brothers in a tireless crusade across the battlefields of the 41st millennium.
enhancements.html: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

rules.name: Devastator Mastery
rules.legend: Unceasing and unmerciful, Adeptus Astartes fire support formations lay waste to all that falls under their gunsights.
rules.html: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Ignores Cover].
  • Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Master-forged Firearms
enhancements.legend: The finest ballistic armaments the Chapter’s artificers can create, these weapons reap a grievous tally of foes.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model’s ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1 A, S, AP and D.

enhancements.name: Honour of Vigilance
enhancements.legend: A savant of applied firepower, this warrior ensures their comrades’ big guns are always optimally positioned and targeted.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.
  • This unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits].
  • If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.

rules.name: Indomitable Defence
rules.legend: The Adeptus Astartes stand as an adamantine wall against any who would assail the Emperor’s realm.
rules.html: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.legend: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.legend: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Gravis unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Immovable Conquerors
enhancements.legend: Once these Gravis-armoured warriors have planted their feet and braced for battle, no force in the galaxy can move them.
enhancements.html: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

enhancements.name: Narthecis Gauntlet
enhancements.legend: This rare supplementary medicae suite allows this Apothecary to provide support to their battle-brothers despite being outfitted for a different role.
enhancements.html: Apothecary Biologis model only. in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

rules.name: Tactical Mastery
rules.legend: Rarely are the Adeptus Astartes deadlier than when they bring to bear the most fundamental teachings of the Codex Astartes.
rules.html: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Codex Astartes dictates when firepower is best used to dismay, disrupt and debilitate the enemy.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Such is the Space Marines’ grasp of adaptive tactics that even the most canny enemies soon find themselves out of position.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

enhancements.name: Laurels of Vigilance
enhancements.legend: Those awarded this prestigious honour are ever vigilant, responding swiftly and with measured force to enemy threats.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Tactical Insight
enhancements.legend: This champion understands the deeper flow of battle, and is always prepared to discern the course of action that will bring assured victory.
enhancements.html: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

rules.name: Enduring Vengeance
rules.legend: Those who pilot Dreadnoughts combine the skill of undying champions with a cold and vengeful hatred of the Emperor’s countless enemies.
rules.html: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.legend: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Dreadnought unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [lethal hits].
  • Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Artificer Sarcophagus
enhancements.legend: Fashioned by an artificer of exceptional skill over an entire lifetime, this sarcophagus resists even the most grievous blows.
enhancements.html: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 D.

enhancements.name: Venerable Champion (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Having won innumerable triumphs, this timeless warrior confers the boon of their martial wisdom upon their battle-brothers.
enhancements.html: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

rules.name: Codex Fire-patterns
rules.legend: Faced with multiple threats that must be efficiently eliminated, the Space Marines employ time-honoured ballistic doctrines to great effect.
rules.html: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.legend: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:
  • [Close-Quarters].
  • [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.name: Cyber-familiar
enhancements.legend: Hovering high overhead on grav-impellers, this small cyber-creature cogitates emergent threats and alerts its master to tactical openings.
enhancements.html: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.legend: The stonewrought reputation and unfaltering determination of this commander serve as a linchpin for even the most hard-pressed strike force.
enhancements.html: Tacticus model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

coreStratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
coreStratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.

TARGET: That unit or model from your army.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.

coreStratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
coreStratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.

coreStratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
coreStratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.

TARGET: One CHARACTER model in your unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.

coreStratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
coreStratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.

TARGET: That unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

coreStratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
coreStratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

coreStratagems.name: TANK SHOCK
coreStratagems.legend: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

coreStratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
coreStratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.

coreStratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
coreStratagems.legend: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.

EFFECT: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

coreStratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
coreStratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

coreStratagems.name: GRENADE
coreStratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

coreStratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
coreStratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

coreStratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
coreStratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

coreStratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
coreStratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:
  • Advance roll
  • Charge roll
  • Damage roll
  • Hazard roll
  • Hit roll
  • Save roll
  • Wound roll
  • A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.

TARGET: That unit or model.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

coreStratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
coreStratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

coreStratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
coreStratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

coreStratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
coreStratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

coreStratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
coreStratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes:

  • Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
+1CP
  • Into the Fray:
    • When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
    • When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

coreStratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
coreStratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit.
  2. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model.
  3. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

coreStratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
coreStratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit.
  2. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit.
  3. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

coreStratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
coreStratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).

EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

coreStratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
coreStratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units).

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

coreStratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
coreStratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.

EFFECT: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

coreStratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
coreStratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.

EFFECT: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

coreStratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
coreStratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.

EFFECT: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

factionRules.name: Space Marine Chapters
factionRules.legend: The many Chapters of Space Marines are spread perilously thin across the Imperium’s countless war zones. Though it is not unheard of for them to fight alongside one another on the same battlefield, far more commonly their strike forces operate alone to defeat seemingly impossible odds.
factionRules.html:
If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES Faction keywords,and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.

You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

factionRules.name: Assigned Agents
factionRules.legend: Throughout the Imperium there exist numerous martial organisations and shadowy institutions. Bodies of armed warriors or solitary agents from these groups possess specialist skills, unusual equipment and vested interests that lead them to be attached to larger Imperial armies. Some are requisitioned by the army’s commander for their particular abilities, others are assigned by their hidden masters to achieve singular agendas. The most powerful have the authority and reputation to enforce their presence on the field of battle.
factionRules.html:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITS
Incursion111
Strike Force221
Onslaught332

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

factionRules.name: Kill Team
factionRules.html:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

factionRules.name: The Ravenwing
factionRules.html:
The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have RAVENWING:
  • MOUNTED units.
  • VEHICLE FLY units.

factionRules.name: The Deathwing
factionRules.html:
The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have DEATHWING:
  • TERMINATOR units.
  • BLADEGUARD ANCIENT, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD and VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS units.
  • LAND RAIDER, LAND RAIDER CRUSADER, LAND RAIDER REDEEMER, REPULSOR and REPULSOR EXECUTIONER units.
  • DREADNOUGHT units.

factionRules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
factionRules.legend: Only while fighting at the side of their battle-brothers can the feral Wulfen control their frenzied aggression.
factionRules.html:
While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not battle-shocked:
  • If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 OC.
  • If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC.
Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

factionRules.name: Sons of Russ
factionRules.html: Your army cannot include APOTHECARY units.

factionRules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
factionRules.html:
• Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models.
  • Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER; GLADIATOR REAPER; GLADIATOR VALIANT; IMPULSOR; REPULSOR; REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

factionRules.name: Combat Doctrines
factionRules.legend: The Space Marines draw upon the combat doctrines of the Codex Astartes as they flow through each phase of battle: first hammering the enemy with devastating firepower, then raking them with close-ranged volleys while manoeuvring to deliver a final, crushing assault.
factionRules.html:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE

When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE

This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE

When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:
  • You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
  • Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

factionRules.name: Assault Doctrine
factionRules.html: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

factionRules.name: Tactical Doctrine
factionRules.html: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

factionRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
factionRules.legend: Those Space Marines who rise to positions of command are exceptional strategists and tacticians.
factionRules.html: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

factionRules.name: Librarius
factionRules.legend: Space Marine Librarians advance through the ranks of Lexicanum, then Codicier, then Epistolary, their psychic might and repertoire of powers increasing with their hardwon experience.
factionRules.html:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

factionRules.name: Special Move Types
factionRules.html:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE18.07
SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"
ELIGIBLE IF:
  • Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
  • Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE18.06
SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"
ELIGIBLE IF:
  • Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
  • Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
  • That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase
EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

factionRules.name: Veteran Recruits
factionRules.html:
Your army cannot include the following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units:
  • SCOUT SQUAD units.
  • TERMINATOR SQUAD units.
  • TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD units.

apothecarybiologis.name: Apothecary Biologis
apothecarybiologis.legend: Clad in Gravis armour, the Apothecary Biologis can advance through storms of enemy fire, vivispectrum at the ready to take bio-material samples for later analysis, whether that be xenos flesh, viral weapons casings or esoteric gene-tech.
apothecarybiologis.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol; 1 Servo-armature.

datasheet.name: Vivispectral Analysis Targeting
datasheet.html: This unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Vehicle].

landraider.name: Land Raider
landraider.legend: Land Raiders are mobile fortresses that bear squads of Space Marines through the most furious firestorms without so much as a scratch. Their machine spirits are so potent that if the crew are slain they will take over, making the tank a truly formidable asset.
landraider.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Armoured Tracks; 2 Godhammer Lascannon; 1 Twin Heavy Bolter.
landraider.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 14 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models. Each Gravis/Terminator model takes up the space of 2 models.

datasheet.name: Assault Ramp
datasheet.html: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, units embarked within this unit can make an assault disembark move.
